challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: The heatwave has exposed a real gap in our seasonal article forecasts. I need to test new weather features without waiting for a full review cycle on every experiment. I am willing to accept full formal sign off on the model registry if that process does not block my rapid iteration on the evaluation harness. My priority is speed in testing, not bypassing safety checks on the final model. If the registry review adds a day, I will lose the window to fix the current blind spot. I can document the test cases as we go, but I cannot pause the harness to wait for a committee to read through every log entry before we see if the new features actually improve accuracy.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept full formal sign-off on the model registry in exchange for the ability to iterate rapidly on the evaluation harness without blocking delays.
